risks.risk: Bundle mismatch: the seller may not provide exactly 5 or 10 copies, or may substitute titles/editions.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo showing the full count (all books laid out) and a list of titles included in the 5-copy and 10-copy bundles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a mixed set with possible substitutions/unknown editions (worst case: not guaranteed to be the exact titles/editions shown).

risks.risk: Condition risk: photos can’t confirm page condition, missing pages, water damage, or writing/highlighting inside.
risks.proof: Request 2–3 close-up photos of the inside pages (front matter, middle page, and back cover) showing no stains/tears and no heavy markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly used with unknown internal condition (worst case: may have markings or minor damage).

risks.risk: Authenticity/edition risk: editions/ISBN aren’t visible; could be reprints or different editions.
risks.proof: Request photos of the back cover and/or ISBN barcode for at least 2 titles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used copies with unknown edition (worst case: lower value than specific editions).

risks.risk: Quantity availability risk: seller may show a stack but may not have enough copies to fulfill 10-copy orders.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the remaining stock count or a short video panning across the full inventory.
risks.if_unproven: Price as limited availability (worst case: may not be able to supply the full requested quantity).

proof_requests: A photo/video showing the exact number of books available for the 5-copy bundle and the 10-copy bundle (count clearly visible).
A list of the titles included in each bundle (5-copy and 10-copy) and whether they are the same titles or mixed.
Close-up photos of inside pages (front, middle, back) to confirm no missing pages, water damage, or heavy writing.
ISBN/back-cover photos for at least 2 titles to confirm edition/authenticity.
response.reason: The photos show multiple business/self-help book titles, but they do not confirm the exact bundle quantity (5 vs 10), whether titles/editions match, or the internal condition—so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set without the missing proof.
